newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Amper looking for domestic acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Amper looking for domestic acquisitions.

text.p: Spanish phone equipment producer Amper has a high level of reserves and is looking for acquisitions, its chief executive Eugenio Vela said.

"Amper group made an investment plan which includes tens of companies. We expect to indentify two precise target in the coming months and close the acquisition before year end," Vela told reporters at a press conference on Thursday.
He added the company was mainly looking for acqusitions inside Spain, but he mentioned also a U.S.-based company.

Vela added after the sale to Siemens SA, Spanish unit of Siemens AG, of the 80 percent of Amper Elasa and of the 10 percent of Amper Datos, Amper group counts on shareholders equity for 15 billion pesetas and further reserve for 12 billion.
